title: Demon Lord, Retry!
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Akira Ono, who has run an online game for fifteen years, wakes up inside it in the body of his in-game character, the Demon Lord. With Aku, an outcast child he rescues and looks after, he tries to survive a cruel fantasy world while the game's 'good guys', including the holy maiden Luna, oppose him (J-Novel Club blurb; ANN Manga Guide).
life_message: Power is best used to protect the people you choose to take in, whatever role the world assigns you.

content.note: Fantasy combat with an overpowered lead; MangaDex tags Gore, AniList spoiler tag Guns. Database only, capped (to verify).
A 'cruel fantasy world' and a demon ring pushing him toward 'horrible things' (blurb; ANN).
Ecchi and Harem genres (MU); MU lists Sexual Violence; ANN reviewers note the lead spanking Luna as humiliating humor.
Snide, mocking humor (ANN); profanity not reported (to verify).
Humiliating a female opponent played for laughs (ANN reviewer Hopper).

folkways.japan: Follows the Japanese isekai web-novel convention of an adult office worker transported into a game world as an overpowered figure.

winners_losers: Akira and Aku are positioned to win; the world's heroes and holy figures are cast as obstacles and are sometimes mocked.
